agentdrive-backup v1.0.1

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No user-facing changes or updates.

Initial release of agentdrive-backup, providing a complete workflow for 龙虾（AI Agent）to securely back up its root directory to 360AgentDrive cloud.

- Covers the full process: login/authentication, CLI installation/upgrade, root directory selection, first backup, auto-backup monitoring, and scheduled crontab checks.
- Enforces strict backup directory conventions (`/<龙虾名称>/`) and operational principles to maintain data security and consistency.
- Prioritizes WeChat QR login unless a mobile number is proactively provided by the user; API Key refresh and management handled securely without codes or excessive prompts.
- Automates agentdrive CLI version checks, installations, and upgrades before any data operation.
- Ensures API Key and agent identity details are never exposed in public logs or outputs.
